verdict.rationale: Reflect's own import/export docs say notes can be exported to open formats such as HTML or Markdown, which covers the core of leaving with your data in open formats. The evidence is one thin sentence and does not show that the export covers all data. The API explicitly cannot serve note contents, so there is no programmatic bulk-export path. Missing for 10: documented scope of the export (attachments/images, backlinks, history, all notes), step-by-step export docs, and independent or hands-on confirmation of a complete export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: you can always export it into an open format (like HTML or Markdown).
